roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/insight-stack/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo findings in insight-stack-data.ts and keep the `must` lines. The single InsightCard stays the kit component for one finding.
intent: A ranked AI summary in one card: an icon, eyebrow and time with an X, a title and source, then the findings as an ordered list. Each finding has a rank Count, a title with its change (kit Delta, or a tone-coloured amount), a one-line detail and a Why? toggle that opens a confidence Meter and the evidence. Loading shows Skeleton rows; no findings is a compact all-clear card. Footer: See all and Ask in Chat, outline sm.
useWhen: Several AI findings about the same data, ranked, where people want to know why each one is there
A dashboard or home summary that changes daily, with a way to ask about it in Chat
doNotUseWhen: One finding or recommendation — use InsightCard
A list of things a person must act on — use NeedsAttention or AgentInbox

title.note: The card heading (h3), e.g. "Three things changed this month". Names the article.

source.note: Where the findings come from, e.g. "Billing, product and CRM · last 30 days". Describes the article.

eyebrow.note: Caller copy beside the icon, e.g. "Summary · 3 of 7 insights", "Summary · Updating", "Summary · All clear". Not an enum and not a heading.

meta.note: Timestamp beside the X, e.g. "09:00". Tabular numbers.

items.note: InsightStackItem[], most important first: { id, title, detail, delta?, tone, goodWhen?, why: { confidence, value, evidence[] } }. delta with a sign (+$18.4k, −3%, +2.4 pt) renders a kit Delta sm with tone (and goodWhen, so churn reads "Worse · +2.4 pt"); an unsigned amount ($1,360) is tone-coloured text with no arrow. No filled chips. why.confidence is the visible string ("High · 82%"), why.value 0–100 for the Meter. Empty and not loading is the all-clear state: CircleCheck icon, the caption, and only Ask.

caption.note: All-clear only: the line under the title, e.g. "Changes over 5% show up here first".

size.note: sm 20rem (320), md 24rem (384), lg 28rem (448). sm uses space-4 padding and a body-size title (type.size.body / type.line.uiMd); md and lg use space-6 padding and an 18/24 title (type.size.uiLg / type.line.uiLg).

loading.note: Header, title and three Skeleton rows (circle and lines). No findings, no footer, no X. The article is aria-busy and a visually hidden role=status reads loadingLabel.

loadingLabel.note: The short status spoken while loading.

defaultOpenIds.note: string[]: findings whose Why? panel starts open.

onDismiss.note: Shows the X: kit IconButton sm (32), ghost neutral, named by KitLabels dismiss. Not shown while loading.

askLabel.note: Caller label, e.g. "Ask in Chat". With onAsk: outline neutral Button sm with MessageCircle (aria-hidden).

seeAllLabel.note: Caller label, e.g. "See all 7". With onSeeAll: outline neutral Button sm, no icon. Hidden when there are no findings.

seeAllHref.note: Navigates: renders the kit Link (standalone), a real <a>, instead of the Button.

rankLabel.note: (rank: number) => string. The rank Count's spoken name. Default "Rank 1".

requirements: Root is an article labelled by the title (h3) and described by the source
Eyebrow and meta are not headings; the header icon is aria-hidden
The X is an IconButton named by KitLabels dismiss; loading has no X
Findings are an ordered list; each rank Count is aria-hidden with a visually hidden "Rank 1"
Why? is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls (Collapsible's pattern); its chevron is aria-hidden
The open panel is role=region named by Why? and the finding title; a closed panel is hidden
The Meter is named Confidence (KitLabels confidence); "High · 82%" stays visible text
Delta text carries the sign (and Better / Worse with goodWhen)
See all and Ask are outline neutral, never primary
Loading: aria-busy on the article, a role=status with loadingLabel, Skeletons aria-hidden
Kit focus ring on every control

must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (chips, meters, skeletons, buttons, rules)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
Signed changes use kit Delta with tone (goodWhen down where a rise is bad); unsigned amounts are tone-coloured text; no filled chips
See all and Ask are outline neutral sm Buttons; no primary Button in this card
Why? keeps aria-expanded / aria-controls and a named region; do not swap it for Accordion
Loading has no X and no footer; the all-clear state stays in this card (not kit Empty)
Status is never colour alone: Delta shows an arrow or Better / Worse, and amounts sit beside a written detail
defaults: Three findings, the first one ranked with an info Count
Lightbulb in the header, CircleCheck when all clear
Footer right-aligned: See all, then Ask in Chat
snippet: <InsightStackPattern size="lg" eyebrow="Summary · 3 of 7 insights" meta="09:00" title="Three things changed this month" source="Billing, product and CRM · last 30 days" items={insights} seeAllLabel="See all 7" onSeeAll={openInsights} askLabel="Ask in Chat" onAsk={openChat} onDismiss={hide} />
